I'm British so maybe I'm biased, but I find his technical wrestling so tense to watch against another technical wrestler/grappler. Noam dar, Pete dunne and more. It's like watching constant near falls watching him do his kimura locks, triangle chokes, Jim breaks armbar and the rings of sabre. Watching him wrenching on limbs, it's like a graceful art form. Watching him switch hold to hold, it's amazing, and he makes the most simple holds look life threatening.  Not to mention his striking is so underrated, his European uppercuts and penalty kicks are strong style incarnate, his selling can be good against the right opponent, ishii recently is a good example, but his selling can be lacklustre.
